The '''1720 [[FLLA]] World Cup''' was the 13th edition of the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international [[Arraby]] tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of the [[FLLA]]. It was held in [[Etirha]] across [[Atirha]], and was won by [[Praesyu]], who defeated [[Lycroa]] 4-0 in the final.

Held in [[Etirha]] and won by [[Praesyu]] with a 4-0 final-day victory over [[Lycroa]], the 1720 tournament is best remembered for the dominance of the Praesyan attacking line and for the trophy's first lifting by a side that had qualified through the [[AYFVL]] but who had also gone unbeaten across the entire competition. The 4-0 result remains the largest winning margin recorded in any FLLA World Cup final since the [[1660 FLLA World Cup|1660 edition]].
